name: ctf-dispatch
description: Triage-first CTF solving: a dispatcher that classifies a challenge, retrieves a matching method from a bundled Arsenal, and stops at a human checkpoint before any category solver runs.

flag_format.title: Flag format
flag_format.description: The flag pattern used by your CTF, e.g. flag{...}, HTB{...} or CTF{...}. Solvers validate found flags against it. Override at runtime with /ctf-dispatch:setflag.
